words.gloss: protecting the welfare of the subjects

literal: Protecting the subjects' welfare, guarding and cherishing them, punishing crime is not a blemish; it is the king's duty.
translation: To guard and cherish the welfare of his subjects, and to punish crimes, is not a blemish on a ruler; it is his duty.
modern: மக்களைப் பாதுகாத்து, அவர்களைப் பேணி வளர்த்து, குற்றங்களைத் தண்டிப்பது அரசனுக்குப் பழி ஆகாது; அது அவனுடைய கடமையாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the core responsibility of a just ruler. A king must actively protect his citizens (காத்து) and nurture their well-being (ஓம்பி). When he administers justice by punishing crimes (குற்றம் கடிதல்), it should not be viewed as an act of cruelty or a moral blemish (வடு அன்று). Instead, punishing wrongdoers is an essential duty (தொழில்) required to maintain order and safeguard the innocent.
